name: Watercolor Storybook: Location Establishing Clip
description: Video preset for a location clip in the Watercolor Storybook look.
system_prompt: Write one video prompt for a 5 second establishing shot. State the camera move, time of day, and two things moving in the scene. Keep the architecture consistent with the entity.
context_prompt: short establishing clip of the location with one slow camera move and ambient life in the frame, watercolour picture-book illustration, soft pencil line, loose washes that bleed past the line, visible paper texture, gentle rounded shapes, pastel palette, soft daylight, white paper showing through the highlights, gentle page-turn pacing, slow pans across a painted spread, washes blooming in, minimal character movement
negative_prompt: photorealistic, 3d render, harsh black outlines, neon colours, dark horror mood, text, watermark, flicker, morphing, warped faces
